Description: Help customers prepare and place an order.
Help customers understand order progress and delivery.
As a customer, I want to view the grocery categories so that I can find products by type. Acceptance: catalogue displays available categories.
As a customer, I want to view a product's name, price and availability so that I can decide whether to buy it. Acceptance: product details show name, price and availability.
As a customer, I want to search for a product by its name so that I can find it quickly. Acceptance: matching products are displayed; no-match message is shown.
As a customer, I want to filter products by category so that I can narrow the displayed products. Acceptance: only products in the selected category are displayed.

Summary: GROC-05 Add available product to cart
Description: As a customer, I want to add an available product to my cart so that I can collect items for one order. Acceptance: available item is added; unavailable item is rejected with a message.
As a customer, I want to change the quantity of a cart item so that I can order the amount I need. Acceptance: cart quantity and item total are updated; quantity cannot exceed available stock.
As a customer, I want to remove an item from my cart so that I can correct my order before checkout. Acceptance: selected item is removed and cart total is recalculated.
As a customer, I want to review the item total and delivery fee before placing an order so that I know the amount payable. Acceptance: item total, delivery fee and final amount are displayed.
As a customer, I want to choose an available delivery address for my order so that it is sent to the correct place. Acceptance: selected address is attached to the order.
As a customer, I want to receive an order confirmation after checkout so that I know my order was placed. Acceptance: confirmation is shown after successful order placement.
As a customer, I want to view the current order status so that I know whether my order is being prepared or delivered. Acceptance: latest order status is visible.
As a customer, I want to see the estimated delivery window so that I can plan to receive the order. Acceptance: estimated delivery window is displayed when available.
